name: search3_charge
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();q=['"uniform-personalization" "PageRank" proof','"Maximizing PageRank via outlinks" conjecture proof optimal swap','"Ninove" "Conjecture 4.34"']
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'search3-plan.json'],input=json.dumps(dict(queries=q,purpose='Focused current public proof and final source qualification for exact PageRank conjecture')),capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'charge_search.py'),str(p/'search3-plan.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
